description: Overnight Calm | Bansuri Sleep Music | 3 Hours of slow, continuous bamboo flute to help you fall asleep and stay asleep all night.

When the day won't switch off, let the bansuri carry it down. Three hours of soft, unbroken bamboo flute in Raga Yaman, the evening raga, with no percussion and nothing to pull you back — a deep, warm bed of sound to sleep right through the night.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume, screen off. It loops seamlessly for the whole night.
⏱ BEST FOR — falling asleep · staying asleep · night-time calm · deep rest
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Yaman is the great evening raga of Indian classical music, played for centuries to settle the mind at nightfall.
